hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Extract all trending topic labels prefixed with the pound sign from tweets posted in February 2024 and rank them by frequency.

hints.title: Iterative Extraction
hints.text: Since a single tweet may contain multiple hashtags, iteratively isolate one hashtag at a time using string replacement.

hints.title: Recursive Structure
hints.text: Use a recursive CTE to pop hashtags matching regex pattern until no symbols remain. Group by hashtag, order descending by count, and return top three.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH RECURSIVE FebruaryTweets AS (
    SELECT * 
    FROM Tweets 
    WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29'
),
HashtagToTweet AS (
    SELECT 
        REGEXP_SUBSTR(tweet, '#[^[:space:]]+') AS hashtag, 
        REGEXP_REPLACE(tweet, '#[^[:space:]]+', '', 1, 1) AS remaining_tweet 
    FROM FebruaryTweets
    WHERE tweet LIKE '%#%'
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        REGEXP_SUBSTR(remaining_tweet, '#[^[:space:]]+') AS hashtag, 
        REGEXP_REPLACE(remaining_tweet, '#[^[:space:]]+', '', 1, 1) AS remaining_tweet 
    FROM HashtagToTweet 
    WHERE remaining_tweet LIKE '%#%'
)
SELECT 
    hashtag, 
    COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM HashtagToTweet 
WHERE hashtag IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hashtag 
ORDER BY count DESC, hashtag DESC 
LIMIT 3;
```

complexity.notes: Recursive CTE tokenization followed by aggregation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Single substring extraction ignores secondary hashtags in the same post.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use recursive CTE or regex token extraction to parse arbitrary counts of hashtags.

solutions.approach: Recursive Common Table Expression Regex Tokenizer
solutions.code:
WITH FebruaryTweets AS (
    SELECT 
        tweet_id,
        (REGEXP_MATCHES(tweet, '#[^[:space:]]+', 'g'))[1] AS hashtag
    FROM Tweets
    WHERE tweet_date BETWEEN '2024-02-01' AND '2024-02-29'
)
SELECT 
    hashtag, 
    COUNT(*) AS count 
FROM FebruaryTweets
WHERE hashtag IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY hashtag 
ORDER BY count DESC, hashtag DESC 
LIMIT 3;
